purpose: Classify 33 nested small landuse=residential extras as clear residential complexes/buildings, plausible neighborhoods/localities, or uncertain; suggest picker exclusions separately without deleting master catalog entries.

classificationDefinitions.clear_residential_complex_or_building: Direct name and geometry-role evidence indicates housing development/individual residential parcel rather than a named locality; candidate picker exclusion only.
classificationDefinitions.plausible_neighborhood_or_locality: Named locality, settlement, ksar, or recognizable neighborhood; preserve pending stronger evidence.
classificationDefinitions.uncertain: Name/source tags do not distinguish a residential parcel from a local place.
